subject: Day 83: schedule the 4-month visit
bodyText:
Today's focus
Closing out week 12, the highest-leverage administrative task is booking the 4-month well visit. Get it on the calendar now so the next vaccine round lands inside its window and the appointment is not pushed back by scheduling lag.

Action items
- Schedule the 4-month well visit for the day 112-126 window. The vaccines due are RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, and IPV #2; there is no HepB dose at this visit. CDC 4-month milestones: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
- Restock infant acetaminophen and confirm the weight-based dose with the pediatrician now, so you are ready for the 24-48h of post-vaccine fussiness and low-grade fever after the 4-month shots. AAP immunization policy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Keep building the freezer milk stash and confirm your pump parts and cooler bag are stocked at work, so the visit and any post-vaccine feeding disruption do not knock the supply off rhythm.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Sleep stretches that lengthen one week and shorten the next. Week-to-week variability at this age is normal and not a sign the routine is failing.
- [monitor] Persistently fisted hands that rarely open, or movement that consistently favors one side. Document it and raise it at the 4-month visit.
- [call within 24h] Acute onset of fever or a new feeding-refusal pattern that does not fit his baseline.
- [call now] Fever of 100.4F rectal or higher under 90 days, apnea, or seizure-like activity. Call same-day, and call 911 for blue lips or labored breathing!

Enrichment opportunities
- Introduce one concept board book this week, such as colors, shapes, or animals, alongside his familiar titles. Repetition remains the vehicle, so keep the new one in heavy rotation rather than reading it once. AAP early literacy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/early-childhood/early-literacy/
- Hold tummy time at 75-90 minutes a day across short bouts. Some infants now tolerate 15-20 minute stretches as head control and forearm push-ups consolidate. AAP Back to Sleep, Tummy to Play: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx
- Hold him in front of a mirror for two to three minutes and let him study the face. Mirror play sharpens the visual and social circuitry that powers his growing preference for familiar people.

Upcoming
- Day 84-91 (~3 months): sleep-consolidation window opens; lock in a consistent sleep-wake routine before the regression.
- Day 112-126 (~4 months): 4-month well visit with RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.
- Day 113-128: expect 24-48h of fussiness and low-grade fever after the 4-month shots.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- Looks at you, moves, or makes sounds to keep your attention
  AAP window: day 70-120
  What to look for: Active engagement — baby is now driving the interaction, not just responding.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/moves-to-get-attention/complete

- Pushes up on elbows during tummy time
  AAP window: day 70-120
  What to look for: Tripod position. Builds toward eventual rolling.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/pushes-up-on-elbows/complete

- Holds a toy when you put it in his hand
  AAP window: day 70-120
  What to look for: Voluntary grasp emerging. Soon followed by reaching.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/holds-toy-when-placed/complete

- Smiles on his own to get your attention
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Initiates the smile rather than responding to yours — emerging social agency.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/smiles-to-get-attention/complete

- Chuckles (not yet a full laugh)
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Throaty soft laugh sounds. Precedes the full belly laugh by a few weeks.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/chuckles/complete
